subject: Encryption key custody and proposed DPA amendment timeline
messages:
From: Sara Hernandez <sara.hernandez@medicore.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: legal@medicore.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Clarification: key custody for UK processing under proposed DPA amendment

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the draft DPA amendment you sent last week. Our legal team has a couple of open items before we can sign off: primarily how Redwood intends to provide an attestation around KMS key custody for UK-resident data (UK IDTA related). We need to confirm:

- Will Redwood hold any customer master keys for MedíCore?
- If not, can you provide a standardized attestation template for the Key Management configuration you support (e.g., customer-managed KMS vs Redwood-managed)?
- Are audit logs (KMS usage + export) included in the TIA evidence package? If so, what retention window applies in the EU region?

We'd like to align on a short amendment to the DPA rather than a full renegotiation. Can you propose a timeline for a signable change? Our procurement is targeting EOW July 30 if feasible.

Best,
Sara
Head of Privacy Programs
MediCore Health
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: sara.hernandez@medicore.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Clarification: key custody for UK processing under proposed DPA amendment

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front:

- Redwood does not retain customer master keys for tenants who opt for customer-managed KMS. We support both customer-managed KMS (CMK) and Redwood-managed keys; the default for our Hosted offering is Redwood-managed unless a customer requests CMK.
- We have a short attestation template for KMS configuration and operational controls (attached: redwood-kms-attestation-template.pdf). It covers custody model, key rotation cadence, and access control boundaries.
- Audit logs for KMS operations and relevant request-level metadata are included in our TIA evidence set; standard retention in EU region is 180 days for request logs and 365 days for key management events unless otherwise contracted.

Actionable next steps I propose:
1) Redwood to provide redlined DPA amendment (we attach a v1 with a new section 5.4 on encryption and key custody).
2) Legal teams to confirm whether the attestation template meets Medicore's needs; if yes, we add it as an Annex.
3) If Medicore requires CMK, we will issue onboarding instructions and an estimated 7-business-day ops window to enable.

I'm looping in Vivek and Marissa for legal and PS timelines. We can push a DocuSign envelope once legal confirms.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-kms-attestation-template.pdf, proposed-dpa-amendment-v1.docx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, sara.hernandez@medicore.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 13:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Clarification: key custody for UK processing under proposed DPA amendment

Sara / Laura — quick legal POV and a couple of clarifying questions from our side:

- The attestation template is fine for an operational statement, but Medicore is asking for an assurance-level statement that typically belongs in a TIA/DTIA appendix. If Medicore needs cryptographic assurances that keys are never exportable from their tenant CMK, we can provide a contractual clause plus a technical onboarding flow for CMK.
- On the UK IDTA front, if MediCore will process UK personal data, we should be explicit whether the keys are generated in a UK-resident KMS instance (we can provision CMK in a UK cloud region). That removes a lot of cross-border questions.

Two asks:
1) Sara — can you confirm whether MediCore requires key generation and key-holding to be physically within the UK? If yes, we will scope the TIA to include UK KMS provisioning.
2) Laura — please add a short rollout timeline in the DPA amendment docx for CMK onboarding and evidence delivery (recommended: onboarding runbook + 7 business days for provisioning + 5 business days for attestation evidence collection).

I'll draft a one-paragraph legal approval block we can insert into the amendment once we have confirmation on the UK residency question.

-Vivek
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
From: legal@medicore.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: sara.hernandez@medicore.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 08:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Clarification: key custody for UK processing under proposed DPA amendment

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick responses. Confirming: MediCore requires that keys protecting UK-personal-data can be generated and remain in a UK region, and that key administration events can be separately audited. We do not require Redwood to give us the key material, but we need a documented proof of configuration and operational logs for a 12-month window for the initial 12-month term.

A couple of notes:
- The proposed 180/365 retention windows are short of our ask. Can Redwood extend the KMS-management events retention to 12 months for this account as a contract amendment?
- We also need the DPA amendment to reference the UK IDTA addendum clause in the event of future regulatory changes.

If Redwood can agree to (1) UK-region CMK provisioning, (2) 12-month retention on management events for the MediCore tenancy, and (3) insertion of a cross-reference to the UK IDTA addendum, we can sign the amendment and aim for DocuSign turnaround by Thursday July 29.

Best,
MediCore Legal
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: legal@medicore.com, sara.hernandez@medicore.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Clarification: key custody for UK processing under proposed DPA amendment

Thanks — agreed to the asks with the following firm commitments:

- Redwood will provision CMK in a UK region for MediCore and confirm the KMS instance name and tenant binding during onboarding. (Ops ETA: 7 business days from signed amendment).
- We will extend KMS-management event retention to 12 months for MediCore as a term in the DPA amendment. Operational logs for request metadata will remain at 180 days unless we include an extended-log addendum (see note below).
- The proposed-dpa-amendment-v1.docx is updated with a new Section 5.4.3 referencing the UK IDTA addendum and an explicit clause for CMK provisioning; attaching the updated draft to the Drive link.

Open items / owners:
- Marissa: update the draft to add the 12-month retention clause and DocuSign envelope (owner: marissa_cole).
- Karthik: produce a TIA mapping table listing which artifacts will be included in the evidence package and their delivery cadence (owner: karthik_iyer). I attached a starter CSV tia-mapping-table.csv to the Drive.
- Ops: prepare an onboarding runbook for CMK (owner: cloud-ops). We estimate 7 business days post-signature.

Sara — if that timeline works, we'll have a redlined version in Drive tonight and push a DocuSign link for signature by EOD Thursday 29 July. If Medicore needs the extended metadata logs (beyond 180 days) we should capture that as a paid add-on in the amendment; I'll have Marissa include language and cost estimate.

Thanks all — Laura
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: proposed-dpa-amendment-v1.docx (updated in Drive), tia-mapping-table.csv, redwood-kms-attestation-template.pdf
